field_meaning.hi: वन-वे लिंक केवल एक दिशा में इंगित करता है।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi meaning 'वन-वे लिंक केवल एक दिशा में इंगित करता है' (One-way link points in only one direction) is tautological and vague. In SEO, it usually refers to a link that does not return a link back (no reciprocal link) or a link that is not crawlable/visible in the same way.
